text:
sanjay: @here FYI we observed a billing/ratelimiting mismatch affecting some Hosted API tenants starting ~13:02 UTC. Requests were served but attributed to the wrong tenant shard, which caused incorrect quota enforcement and a handful of customers to hit sudden rate limits. Adding status link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2432101234

incident-bot: Incident INC-2027-011 created · severity: high · services: ingress-proxy, metering, billing-processor · start: 2027-02-18T13:02:14Z

lena: TL;DR: a deploy to the metering-router introduced a tag-mapping regression where source-ip->tenant resolution fell back to a deprecated header when tenant-cookie was absent. That fallback mapped traffic to a shared shard id causing quota checks to see aggregated usage. Impact window ~13:02-13:17 UTC.

billing: impact summary: 11 tenants experienced unexpected 429s for short windows; no token loss but throttles triggered. We rolled back the metering-router at 13:12 and applied a hotfix to prefer tenant-cookie parsing first.

infra: timeline/commands we ran: `kubectl -n infra logs -l app=metering-router --since=30m | jq -r '.msg' | grep tenant_cookie` and `./tools/meter_audit.sh --start 2027-02-18T12:55Z --end 2027-02-18T13:20Z` — audit shows spike in requests mapped to shard "shared-0" at 13:02.

lena: mitigations performed: 1) rolled back the canary metering-router deploy at 13:12 2) applied hotfix to parsing logic 3) invalidated problematic shard mappings and replayed missing attribution in billing-processor to avoid double-charging.

billing: verification: ran `SELECT tenant_id, count(*) FROM metering_events WHERE ts BETWEEN '2027-02-18 13:00' AND '2027-02-18 13:20' GROUP BY tenant_id;` — we validated that counts reconverge after attribution replay.

support: customer comms: banner posted 13:25 UTC. Draft: "We experienced transient rate-limiting for a small set of customers due to an internal tenant-attribution bug between 13:02-13:17 UTC. A rollback and attribution replay have been applied. If you were rate-limited during this window and still see issues, please contact support with reference INC-2027-011." cc @support

incident-bot: Current status: mitigated · monitoring · link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2432101234 · postmortem: scheduled 2027-02-19T15:00Z

lena: follow-ups: 1) add lint/test to prevent fallback-to-deprecated-header 2) instrument a metric for mapping_entropy to detect shard-smearing early 3) add an automated canary rollback if attribution mismatch rate >0.5%

billing: next actions: run a reconciliation job overnight and prepare customer-specific impact reports for CS to send to affected tenants.

sanjay: thanks team. Please paste any logs/queries into the postmortem doc and ping me for any follow-ups. If anyone observes residual 429s reopen this thread. :white_check_mark:
